title: Putting the three pieces together
objective: Discover the sources with $(wildcard src/*.c), rewrite them into build/ names with $(patsubst), and let a pattern rule build each one into its own directory.
hint: The wildcard decides what exists right now, patsubst rewrites each discovered name into the name you want to build, and the pattern rule knows how to build any name of that shape.

steps.description: each object comes from the source with the same stem
steps.stdout:
compile src/alpha.c into build/alpha.pack with stem alpha
compile src/beta.c into build/beta.pack with stem beta
sources: src/alpha.c src/beta.c
objects: build/alpha.pack build/beta.pack

steps.description: the second run has nothing to rebuild
both objects were written into build/
clean removes the whole build directory
